schemos.payment_failed.schema.json:
{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "title": "payment_failed",
  "description": "Mokejimo klaida. payment_context laukas atskiria kontekstus (checkout vs subscription). Dunning srautas naudoja tik subscription konteksta.",
  "schema_version": 1,
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["schema_version", "event_name", "event_id", "emitted_at", "email", "payload"],
  "properties": {
    "schema_version": {"const": 1},
    "event_name": {"const": "payment_failed"},
    "event_id": {"type": "string"},
    "emitted_at": {"type": "string", "format": "date-time"},
    "email": {"type": "string", "format": "email"},
    "customer_id": {"type": ["integer", "null"]},
    "payload": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["payment_context", "order_id", "attempt_number"],
      "properties": {
        "payment_context": {"type": "string", "enum": ["checkout", "subscription", "manual_admin"]},
        "order_id": {"type": "integer"},
        "subscription_id": {"type": ["integer", "null"]},
        "attempt_number": {"type": "integer"},
        "amount": {"type": "number"},
        "currency": {"type": "string", "enum": ["EUR"]},
        "payment_method": {"type": "string"},
        "failure_reason": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
        "paysera_error_code": {"type": ["string", "null"]}
      }
    }
  }
}
schemos.subscription_t5_notice.schema.json:
{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "title": "subscription_t5_notice",
  "description": "Prenumerata: 5 dienos iki kito ciklo, klausiam kliento patvirtinimo (M10 confirm_required rezimas).",
  "schema_version": 1,
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["schema_version", "event_name", "event_id", "emitted_at", "email", "payload"],
  "properties": {
    "schema_version": {"const": 1},
    "event_name": {"const": "subscription_t5_notice"},
    "event_id": {"type": "string"},
    "emitted_at": {"type": "string", "format": "date-time"},
    "email": {"type": "string", "format": "email"},
    "customer_id": {"type": "integer"},
    "payload": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["subscription_id", "cycle_number", "next_charge_date", "next_charge_amount"],
      "properties": {
        "subscription_id": {"type": "integer"},
        "cycle_number": {"type": "integer"},
        "next_charge_date": {"type": "string", "format": "date"},
        "next_charge_amount": {"type": "number"},
        "product_id": {"type": "integer"},
        "product_name": {"type": "string"},
        "confirm_token": {"type": "string"},
        "skip_token": {"type": "string"},
        "reschedule_token": {"type": "string"},
        "cancel_token": {"type": "string"}
      }
    }
  }
}
